title: Walk through Morne Coubaril's sugar and cocoa estate
supports: Direct Viator product page opened successfully and the itinerary explicitly includes a walk through Morne Coubaril Estate's grounds, interpretation of the historic plantation, fresh cane juice and lunch. The visit is one stop within an approximately 8.5-hour catamaran day.
hidden_gem_rationale: The working estate's agricultural history is overshadowed by nearby Pitons and volcano excursions; classified as a gem.

title: Browse El Alto Market after riding Mi Teleferico
supports: Current Viator itinerary explicitly schedules 30 minutes at El Alto Market after Mi Teleferico; a La Paz municipal tourism study identifies El Alto's Feria 16 de Julio and the cable car as defining visitor experiences.
hidden_gem_rationale: Everyday Aymara market life is distinctive and less internationally prominent than Bolivia's headline landscapes; classified as a gem.

title: Tour the Kiambethu tea estate outside Nairobi
supports: The Viator product is a half-day visit to Kiambethu; the estate's own tour page confirms tea-field interpretation, an indigenous-forest walk and lunch.
hidden_gem_rationale: A small-estate agricultural visit is a quieter cultural counterpoint to Nairobi's headline wildlife circuit.

title: Roast and taste coffee on a farm near Nairobi
supports: The direct product covers a coffee farm tour with roasting and tasting; Fairview's own site confirms field, processing and tasting elements.
hidden_gem_rationale: The visit connects a familiar drink with its Kenyan crop and production process in a hands-on setting.

title: Make pottery by hand in a Marrakech workshop
supports: The product page names Atelier Lamsaty and includes modelling, wheel work and painting; the workshop's own site confirms its Marrakech pottery classes.
hidden_gem_rationale: Making a piece provides direct contact with the craft beyond shopping or watching a demonstration.

title: Cook Cape Malay dishes in a Cape Town home
supports: The Viator page identifies host Lorette, her Grassy Park home and a two-to-three-dish class; Traveling Spoon's host page independently confirms the same host, home format and Cape Malay-influenced menu.
hidden_gem_rationale: A small home setting connects Cape Town history with living family food traditions.

title: Learn to evaluate Rwandan coffee in a specialty masterclass
supports: The direct product is a specialty coffee masterclass in Kigali; Question Coffee's official site lists the same two-hour masterclass at its coffee centre.
hidden_gem_rationale: The class presents a major Rwandan crop through focused tasting and learning at a small scale.

title: Make a silver jewellery piece in Kuta
supports: The direct product is a hands-on Kuta silver-jewellery class; Kuta Silversmith's official class page confirms tools, silver, instruction and a two-to-three-hour format.
hidden_gem_rationale: The participant leaves with a self-made object and encounters a Balinese craft at workshop scale.

title: Repair ceramics with kintsugi in Tokyo
supports: The product page gives the TNCA Minami-Aoyama Studio address and a hands-on repair class; TNCA's official page confirms kintsugi workshops at the same studio.
hidden_gem_rationale: This compact craft session centres an object-repair practice away from landmark sightseeing.

title: Shop a Colombo market and cook Sri Lankan dishes
supports: The product combines a Colombo-area market visit and hands-on Sri Lankan cooking; the operator's official itinerary confirms both parts in a home setting.
hidden_gem_rationale: Combining ingredient selection with cooking makes everyday food culture the centre of the activity.

title: Cook with the Mamas of Zanzibar
supports: The Viator product is a community-hosted Zanzibar cooking experience; Mamas of Zanzibar's official site confirms market ingredients, Swahili cooking and its women-led home experience.
hidden_gem_rationale: The small-group exchange foregrounds local hosts and home food knowledge.

place: Golden Temple Singing Bowls and Healing Center
title: Join a singing-bowl sound bath near Patan's Golden Temple
supports: The product page identifies a one-hour evening session at Golden Temple Singing Bowls and Healing Center in Lalitpur; the centre's own site confirms its location and sound-bath and sound-healing services.
hidden_gem_rationale: This is a compact wellbeing experience that complements longer spiritual and outdoor activities.

place: Kiek in de Kök Fortification Museum
title: Explore Tallinn's underground Bastion Passages
supports: Private tour gives two hours to Tallinn Old Town and one hour in the Bastion Passages; admission to both the passage and Carved Stone Museum is included.
hidden_gem_rationale: Specific underground layer beneath the familiar Old Town; hidden_gem is supported.

title: Walk the archaeological hill forts of Kernavė
supports: Private full-day itinerary visits the Kernavė mounds for one hour before Trakai; the page lists the mounds as free and separately lists a Kernavė museum ticket.
hidden_gem_rationale: Less prominent than nearby Trakai and a distinct early-capital landscape; hidden_gem is supported.

title: Follow Van Gogh's working years through Nuenen village
supports: Nine-hour small-group product travels from Amsterdam to Nuenen for a guided village heritage walk and Vincentre/Van Gogh Village Museum visit, then returns for museum entry and a canal cruise.
hidden_gem_rationale: Specialist village heritage experience beyond the two famous art collections; hidden_gem is supported.

title: Explore the Jervis Bay night sky with an astronomer
supports: Guided telescope session near Huskisson. The operator confirms the exact location before the date; sky visibility and weather affect the experience.
hidden_gem_rationale: A small guided coastal night-sky outing outside the main daytime beach and dolphin circuit; the activity, rather than a famous attraction, is the focus.

title: Ride a fat bike along Culburra Beach
supports: Self-guided fat-bike hire with route information, helmet and lock. Confirm tides, collection arrangements and which sections are suitable to ride.
hidden_gem_rationale: A self-paced local beach cycling route with Crookhaven and community-garden stops, away from the better-known Jervis Bay attraction circuit.

title: Explore Bundanon art and its historic artist estate
supports: Museum admission; the Viator listing includes the homestead and studio on weekends. Confirm current access dates and travel between the two sites with Bundanon.
hidden_gem_rationale: A regional artist estate and museum outside the main city-gallery circuit, offering a specific cultural outing rather than a large tourist attraction.

title: Tour Hoover Dam's powerplant and observation deck
supports: Current Viator page confirms the six-hour tour includes the guided powerplant tour and Visitor Center ticket; the federal operator page separately confirms both the powerplant route and observation deck.

place: Ellis Island National Museum of Immigration
title: Trace immigrant stories at Ellis Island's immigration museum
supports: Direct Viator product page opened successfully and confirms Ellis Island and Immigration Museum access only on the Comprehensive Tour / Ellis Island-including option. The shorter afternoon or Liberty-only option may not allow time for Ellis Island, so the runtime link must present that option gate. NPS confirms the museum and authorised ferry access.

title: Step onto the glass-floored Columbia Icefield Skywalk
supports: Current Viator page confirms Skywalk admission in an approximately 11-hour Banff day tour; the attraction operator confirms the one-kilometre interpretive walkway and glass-floor platform.

title: Look over Vancouver from the Vancouver Lookout
supports: Current Viator page confirms Vancouver Lookout admission and a 45-minute observation-deck stop; the Lookout's own visitor page confirms one-time observation-deck access.

title: Zipline above the jungle at Nohoch Che'en
supports: Current Viator page explicitly confirms a zipline over rainforest and rivers at Nohoch Che'en within an eight-hour combo; a Belize operator corroborates ziplining at Nohoch Che'en National Park.

title: Take in Panama City's skyline from the Amador Causeway
supports: Current Viator itinerary gives Amador Causeway a 50-minute stop; Panama's official tourism site confirms the skyline and canal-entrance views from the causeway.

title: Tackle the Gully Obstacle Course at Harrison's Cave
supports: Current Viator page confirms the 14-element obstacle course and protective equipment; Chukka's own park page confirms the supervised Gully Challenge Course.

title: Swim in Jamaica's Blue Hole near Ocho Rios
supports: Current Viator itinerary confirms 90 minutes with admission at Blue Hole; Jamaica's official tourism site confirms swimming in the spring-fed lagoon near Ocho Rios.

title: Relax on Luquillo Beach after El Yunque
supports: Current Viator itinerary gives Luquillo Beach two hours; Puerto Rico's official destination site confirms La Monserrate's calm water, golden sand and beach-day facilities.

title: Explore an Indigenous cave in Arikok National Park
supports: Current Viator title and meeting details identify ABC Tours' Natural Pool and Indian Cave safari; ABC Tours' own page explicitly confirms cave exploring and Indian Caves in Arikok National Park.

title: Stand before the seven ocean-facing moai of Ahu Akivi
supports: Direct Viator product page opened successfully and confirms a 45-minute Ahu Akivi stop on day one of a three-day package. Rapa Nui National Park admission is not included and must be obtained separately.

title: Walk the sacred trail above Guatavita Lagoon
supports: Direct Viator product page opened successfully and explicitly includes a guided 40-to-90-minute walk around Guatavita Lagoon. Reserve admission is not included in every product option; travellers must select an admission-including option or pay the reserve entry separately.

title: Watch a train pass through Maeklong Railway Market
supports: The Viator combination tour explicitly visits Maeklong Railway Market; Thailand's official tourism site confirms the working market and scheduled train passages.

title: Cook a Moroccan meal in Marrakech
supports: The direct product is a La Maison Arabe Moroccan cooking workshop; the hotel's official school page confirms visitor classes led step by step by traditional dadas.

title: Tour the Doge's Palace and cross the Bridge of Sighs
supports: The 4–6 hour product includes a pre-reserved Doge's Palace ticket, guided interior visit, Bridge of Sighs and New Prisons. Access can change during private events.

title: Enter St Mark's Basilica with a guide
supports: The 4–6 hour product includes a timed Basilica ticket and about one hour inside; liturgical closures can substitute an exterior explanation.

title: Ride a traditional gondola along Venice's canals
supports: The product includes a 30-minute traditional gondola ride on the Grand Canal in its main options; the shorter Venice Express option excludes the gondola, and weather can cause substitution. Draft title was corrected from 'smaller canals' because the page verifies the Grand Canal route.

title: See Renaissance masters inside the Uffizi Gallery
supports: Approximately 4 hours 18 minutes; the itinerary assigns two hours to the Uffizi with admission included, after an Accademia visit and central Florence walk.

title: Tour Windsor Castle's State Apartments and St George's Chapel
supports: Eleven-hour coach departure from London; the inclusive itinerary lists one hour in Windsor Castle and 15 minutes at St George's Chapel with admission included, plus Stonehenge and Bath.

title: Cruise among the islands of Oslo Fjord
supports: Two-hour sightseeing boat trip departing from the Oslo City Hall waterfront with onboard commentary; port transfers are not included.

title: Soak in the Secret Lagoon after the Golden Circle
supports: Ten-hour small-group Reykjavik departure includes admission and soaking time at Gamla Laugin after Golden Circle stops and a tomato-farm visit.

title: Climb to Bled Castle above the lake
supports: Full-day Ljubljana departure schedules one hour at Bled Castle and describes entering its museum; Bled Castle admission is paid separately, as are the other attraction admissions.

title: Climb Nea Kameni's volcanic crater and swim by Palea Kameni
supports: Approximately 10.5 hours; the boat lands for the Nea Kameni crater walk, continues to the Palea Kameni hot springs for swimming, then visits Thirasia and Oia. Volcano admission is paid separately.

title: Walk Cascais's Atlantic waterfront on a Sintra coast trip
supports: Five-hour guided departure from Lisbon includes a distinct Cascais beach-town stop after Sintra, Pena Palace and Cabo da Roca; Pena admission is included.

title: Enter Seville Cathedral beneath the Giralda
supports: Four-hour city tour includes Cathedral admission and a 45-minute interior visit plus the Alcázar; on Sundays and bank holidays the Cathedral can be replaced due to religious services.

title: Abseil and swim through Empress Canyon
supports: Guided canyoning and abseiling from Katoomba with technical equipment. Check the operator requirements, current canyon conditions and exact meeting time.

title: Paddle the Shotover River white-water rapids
supports: Guided Shotover River rafting with Queenstown transfer and equipment. Participants must be able to swim and meet the operator age and weight requirements.
